name: RobotTraining.jobs MCP Server
summary: Keyless remote MCP server and read-only JSON/CSV data API listing open robot-training jobs (teleoperation, data collection, AV and drone testing) and their advertised pay.
description: MCP tool `search_robot_training_jobs` covers roles across about 70 employers and programs (per the tool description). Data endpoints: /roles.json, /pay.json, /pay.csv. Listed in the official MCP Registry as jobs.robottraining/robot-training-jobs. Submitted via the listing-request queue.
